$comment: Documented precedence for every field where Meridian's sources disagree. The pipeline reads this file; it is not hard-coded in the resolver. Each rule cites the evidence that justifies it so an evaluator can audit the choice, not just the outcome.

fleet_master.why: Transcribed from the RC (registration certificate). Orion Pharma verify vehicle year against the RC copy at their gate, so the RC is the only reading that has operational consequences.

maintenance_log.why: Workshop entries are made against the odometer photo. Ops explicitly ruled the workshop reading the reference over hub yard checks.

meridian_trips.why: System of record for what actually moved, but it carries no vehicle attributes.

drivers_roster.why: HR system of record; drives the six-month night-solo eligibility rule.

tickets.why: Authoritative that an incident happened and where, but its vehicle/driver fields are free-typed and must be resolved against the masters before use.

emails.why: Authoritative for what a client has committed to (SLA windows, gate timings, rotation demands). NOT authoritative for vehicle or asset facts - hub staff misquote the fleet master in them.

dispatcher_interview.why: The only written record of the real dispatch rulebook. Superseded only by a client email that states a stricter commitment.

field_rules.why: Where fleet_master.csv holds two rows for one registration, the row carrying an MF- vehicle_id is the master record; the id-less row is a re-import that was never reconciled. Confirmed by the id-less rows also being the ones missing capacity_tonnes and engine_heater.
Master row wins; where the master row is silent, fill the gap from the duplicate rather than discarding a known value.
Workshop odometer photo is the reference. Readings that decrease over time are surfaced as a data-quality conflict, not silently averaged.

The same plate appears as UP40IM3144, UP-40-IM-3144 and 'UP 40 IM 3144' across five sources. Canonical key strips separators and uppercases; the display form is re-rendered in the standard XX-00-XX-0000 shape.
